verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a first-party MCP server at mcp.secureframe.com that exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as MCP tools. Any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can connect via a sign-in-and-approve OAuth flow with no secrets in config files, and a headless path covers CI and scripts. A probe confirms an official secureframe-mcp-server GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works in practice, and detail on the full tool list and write-action coverage.
